name: Carpet Cleaning Simulator
desc:
Current Version: 1.0.7

🧼Scrub. Spray. Restore. 🧼

Welcome to Scrubby's Carpet Cleaning. Take on filthy, stained carpets and bring them back to life one room at a time. No timers, no pressure, just the satisfying pull of a dirty carpet turning clean.

🧽 Satisfying, realistic cleaning that actually feels good
💼 Work your way up: new jobs, bigger messes, better gear
🐾 Hatch cute companions who scrub alongside you
🏠 Cozy, quiet spaces waiting to be restored
✨ Smooth, calming gameplay built for zoning out
🐀 ...and the occasional unexpected guest (hey Robbie~)
  &  Jorny.

Put on some music, zone out, enjoy the process.
Sometimes it's not about winning. It's about making things clean again!
